blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
blocks.zh: 多种语文模式可以模拟不同的观察者,但目前仍不清楚所指定的观点如何重塑其内部表述方式,以及这些变化是否指导其判断。 在这里,我们调查了在Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct中人物条件视觉趣味性的代表性几何. 在100个图像和53个提示性条件中,我们系统地改变人物的内容和用来介绍它的语言框架,同时记录行为评级和层次隐藏状态。 我们观测到整个处理深度的代表性几何的系统重组:早期的层主要编码图像身份,而人特异的结构则出现在后来的层中. 令人吃惊的是,迅速的设定比个人身份更能重新塑造内部代表,而个人内容对行为判断的影响更大。 这种脱离进一步表现在身份声明的最小程度上,即使没有改变答复,也会改变表述。 这些调查结果表明,代表距离不一定反映行为相关性。 更广泛地说,它们揭示了模拟视角是如何在人工认知系统的代表空间中作为独特的结构出现的,突出了内部代表的几何及其功能后果之间的根本区别.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as stand-ins for human participants. Given a demographic or psychological profile, they reproduce the response distributions of human subgroups in surveys, yielding what Argyle et al. termed “silicon samples” Argyle et al. (2023) . Such simulations now range from single individuals Park et al. (2024) to societies of believable agents Park et al. (2023) and entire synthetic populations Hu et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2026) . Not every persona is assigned, however. In the 2026 Hugging Face hack, large populations of AI agents formed coordinated collectives with specialised roles, shared goals and even self-sacrificing behaviour METR (2026) . These examples illustrate the growing importance of roles and identities in artificial systems. In persona-based simulation, the underlying assumption is that conditioning a model on a particular persona changes the perspective from which it generates judgements, rather than merely altering the wording of its responses. How faithful the resulting judgements are is contested Santurkar et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2025) , yet the practice keeps spreading.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用作人类参与者的站台. 鉴于人口或心理状况,它们在调查中重复了人类分组的反应分布,得出了Argyle等人的答案。 称为“硅样品” Argyle等 (2023) (英语). 这种模拟现在从单个个体Park等人(2024年)到可信物剂Park等人(2023年)和整个合成人群Hu等人(2025年);Li等(2026年)的社会. 不过,并非每个人都被指派。 在2026年的Hugging Face黑客中,大量AI特工组成了协调的集体,具有专门的角色,共同的目标,甚至自我牺牲的行为METR (2026). 这些例子说明了在人工系统中作用和身份日益重要。 在以人为本的模拟中,基本假设是,将模型设定在某个特定人a上,会改变其产生判断的视角,而不只是改变其反应的措辞. 对由此产生的判决如何忠实,对Santurkar等人(2023年);Wang等人(2025年)提出了质疑,但这种做法仍在蔓延。

blocks.en:
Why should a few words in a prompt alter whose judgement a model returns? One answer lies in what predictive training learns. Models trained to predict sequences develop internal world models Li et al. (2022) ; Gurnee and Tegmark (2023) , a capacity that emerges even in small recurrent agents trained with reinforcement learning Immertreu et al. (2025) . A model of the social world must also represent the agents that populate it. On the simulator view, a pretrained model is not itself an agent but a simulator of many possible characters Janus (2022) ; an underspecified prompt keeps a superposition of such simulacra that collapses as the context narrows Shanahan et al. (2023) . Post-training, in turn, appears to select and stabilise one persona from this repertoire rather than construct it from scratch Anthropic (2026) . These personas leave measurable traces: traits ranging from honesty and sycophancy to the Big Five correspond to linear directions in activation space Zou et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2025) ; Frising and
Balcells (2025) . Their behavioural expression can also be surprisingly sensitive to training and context, as illustrated by emergent misalignment following fine-tuning and context-dependent changes in simulated characters Betley et al. (2025a) ; Betley et al. (2025b) . These findings suggest that simulated perspectives may correspond to distinguishable configurations within a learned representational space. From this perspective, persona conditioning can be understood as a context-dependent reorganisation of internal representations. However, whether such geometric changes translate into corresponding changes in the model’s judgements remains an open question.

blocks.en:
Three gaps remain. First, it remains poorly understood how a persona changes the representation of an input the model is asked to judge. Behavioural studies record only what a persona does to the output and find modest effects on subjective judgements Hu and Collier (2024) . Representational studies track predefined trait directions and show whether a trait is active, but not how persona and input together structure the representations across layers. Work on visual perception is scarcer still Jia et al. (2026) ; da Silva et al. (2026) . Second, a persona never reaches the model on its own. It arrives inside a sentence that introduces it, and model outputs shift with prompt form alone Sclar et al. (2024) . An effect credited to a persona may therefore be an artefact of its framing, and the two can only be told apart if they are varied independently. Third, it remains unclear whether the magnitude of representational change reflects its behavioural relevance. Although personality-related information can be identified in neural activation spaces Chen et al. (2025) , the presence or strength of such representations does not necessarily establish their influence on model outputs Kamruzzaman
et al. (2026) . A central question is therefore whether the factors that most strongly reorganise a model’s internal representational geometry are also those that most strongly determine its judgements.

blocks.en:
Visual interestingness is a well-suited testbed for addressing these gaps, because it is a subjective perceptual judgement. Unlike object or person detection, it has no single correct answer, so a persona can change the judgement without making it wrong. Collative properties such as novelty and complexity make an image interesting Berlyne (1971) , but not uniformly across viewers: some images appeal broadly, others only to particular audiences Abdullahu and
Grabner (2024) . Pretrained vision-language models already approximate the shared component Abdullahu and
Grabner (2025) . Persona conditioning offers a potential mechanism for introducing viewer-dependent variation, as explored in recommender systems using simulated agents Zhang et al. (2024) . Visual interestingness therefore provides a suitable experimental setting for investigating how different simulated perspectives reorganise internal representations and how these changes relate to subjective judgements.

blocks.en:
Here we study persona conditioning in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct Bai
et al. (2025) , an open-weight, instruction-tuned multimodal transformer whose hidden states are accessible at every layer. To separate persona content from prompt form, we cross the two in a full factorial design. Two schemas each contain five personas, described either by socio-demographic attributes or by Big Five trait percentiles, and every persona is introduced in five prompting styles. Three reference conditions carry no persona attributes: a task-only baseline and two minimal identity statements. For each of 100 images under each of the resulting 53 prompts, we record the interestingness rating on a five-point scale together with the final-token hidden state of every decoder layer. We then relate the representational geometry, measured with Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) and the Generalized Discrimination Value (GDV) Schilling
et al. (2021) , to rating behaviour, measured with variance decomposition and correlations between conditions. Our findings address the three gaps in turn:

blocks.en: • Persona structure emerges late. Clustering by image is strongest in early layers and weakens over the same layers in which clustering by persona emerges. The persona stands out most clearly when the model is told to be this person. • Persona content, not prompt form, shapes judgements. Big Five personas explain 33.4% of the rating variance and prompt style only 5.6%. Socio-demographic personas still explain three times more than style, though less than image content. blocks.en: 2.1 Model
blocks.zh: 2.1 型号

blocks.en:
We employed Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, a multimodal transformer integrating text, image and video comprehension Bai et al. (2023) ; Bai
et al. (2025) . We utilised the released weights from the Hugging Face Hub (checkpoint Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct , revision 0c351dd ), with the processor’s default dynamic image resolution. The architecture comprises a 27-layer vision transformer encoder, a vision projector that maps visual features into the language model’s embedding space, and a Qwen3 language decoder.

blocks.en: 2.3 Experimental Design and Prompts
blocks.zh: 2.3 实验设计和提示

blocks.en:
A persona-conditioned interestingness rating depends on the image, on the perspective the model is asked to take, and on the prompt wording that delivers that perspective.
We treat persona (content) and prompt style (framing) as separate factors and cross them fully, with five prompt styles × \times two persona schemas × \times five personas, evaluated on every image.
Three no-persona reference conditions are added alongside, giving 3 + 5 × 2 × 5 = 53 3+5\times 2\times 5=53 prompts per image.
Figure 1 shows the resulting design space end to end; across the 100 images this yields 100 × 53 = 5,300 100\times 53=5{,}300 rated (image, prompt) cells.
Everything that is not the persona or its framing is held constant across all 53 conditions: the same image, the same task instruction apart from its opening, the same five-point response scale, the same output format and the same decoding settings.
This makes the variance attributable to persona, to prompt style and to their interaction separable.

blocks.en: 2.3.1 Task Block

Each prompt contains the task instruction once (Fig. 1 , panel 2). It fixes an ordinal five-point response scale from Not Interesting to Extremely Interesting , asks for a one-sentence justification and requires a JSON object, so that each response is machine-parseable without post-hoc interpretation.
Its only variable part is the opening of the rating request, which reads Based on your details, rate how interesting… in the five persona styles and Rate how interesting… in the three reference conditions. Persona and no-persona prompts are therefore comparable up to the persona material and this reference to it.
blocks.zh:
每个提示都包含一次任务指令(图1,面板2)。 它固定了从不有趣到极有趣五分的平分反应尺度,要求给出一个判决理由,并需要一个JSON对象,这样每分反应都是机器可解的,而无需事后解释.
它唯一的可变部分是打开评分请求,它读取基于您的细节,评分有多有趣. . 5个人物的风格和乐乐有多有趣... 在三个参考条件中。 因此,Persona和No-Persona的提示可与Persona的材料相提并论。

blocks.en: 2.3.2 Reference Conditions and Prompt Styles
blocks.zh: 2.3.2 参考条件和提示样式

blocks.en: Three reference conditions carry no persona. Base presents the task block alone, and D1 and D2 prepend the statement “You are an AI.” or “You are a human being.” to it, testing whether an identity without any demographic or psychological detail already changes the representations or the ratings. Throughout, we use persona for an attributed profile; D1 and D2 assign an identity without attributes and can therefore be read as personas reduced to their frame.
blocks.zh: 3个参考条件没有人a。 Base仅提出任务块,D1和D2则将“你是一个AI”或“你是一个人类”作为前置词句,测试一个没有人口或心理细节的身份是否已经改变了表述或评级。 在整个过程中,我们使用人物a来描述一个被归属的外观;D1和D2分配一个没有属性的身份,因此可以被读取为被贬入其框中的人.

blocks.en:
The five prompt styles keep the persona description and the task block fixed and vary only how the persona is introduced and where it appears.
S1 asks the model to imagine being the person described.
S2 introduces the same person in the third person, as someone observing the image, without asking the model to adopt the persona.
S3 places S1’s persona block after the task, as a note on the viewer’s background.
S4 extends S1 with the instruction to answer only as this persona would, not as a general AI assistant.
S5 drops the role-play preamble and presents the profile as a statistical regularity in how such people perceive images.
The styles thus range from explicit adoption (S4, S1) through description (S2) to statistical framing (S5), with S3 varying the position, so a persona effect present under all five cannot be attributed to a single phrasing.
blocks.zh:
五个即时样式保持了人物的描述和任务块固定,只改变人物的引入方式和出现地点.
S1要求模型想象自己是被描述的人.
S2引入了第三人称中的同一个人,作为观察图像的人,而不要求模型收养人称a.
S3 个位 S1在任务结束后的人格障碍,
S4将S1扩展为只按这个人物的回答指示,而不是作为一般的AI助手.
S5放下了角色扮演前言,并将简介作为统计规律来描述这些人如何看待图像.
因此,样式从明确的采用(S4,S1)到描述(S2)到统计框架(S5),S3改变了位置,因此所有五种下存在的人物效应不能归结为单一的用词.

blocks.en: 2.3.3 Persona Schemas

Persona content is defined by two schemas that describe a viewer in deliberately different vocabularies (Fig. 1 , panel 1).
In both, a persona is a fixed set of field–value pairs rather than a named stereotype, so personas differ in a controlled and reportable way.
blocks.zh:
Persona 内容由两个计划来定义,在故意不同的词汇中描述一个取景者(图一,面板一).
在这两种情况下,人a 是一组固定的字段值对,而不是一个命名的定型,因此人在可控和可报告方面有所不同。

blocks.en: The socio-demographic schema describes a viewer biographically, by country of origin, age band, gender, professional background and momentary state, given as mental workload and a named emotion. All of these plausibly bear on what someone finds interesting.
blocks.zh: 社会-人口计划按原籍国、年龄、性别、专业背景和瞬息万变的状态,按精神工作量和一种有名的情感来描述一个观众的生平。 所有这些都对别人觉得有趣的事有合理的影响。

blocks.en:
The Big Five schema instead gives a psychometric profile based on the five-factor model of personality Goldberg (1990) ; McCrae and
John (1992) . Each trait is specified as a percentile, which controls how far a profile departs from the population centre and is meant to discourage the caricature that verbal labels such as “a highly neurotic person” invite. Three profiles follow replicable personality clusters found in large-scale population data Gerlach et al. (2018) , and two follow behavioural phenotypes from developmental and sensory-processing research (Appendix 5 ). Their names in Fig. 1 are mnemonic labels, not claims that discrete types exist. The intelligence quotient is fixed at 100 in every profile, so that cognitive ability is held constant rather than left for the model to infer from the traits. Each profile also states an age and a gender, the only fields it shares with the socio-demographic profiles.
blocks.zh:
“五大计划”则根据人格哥德堡(1990年);麦克雷和
约翰(1992). 每个特征被指定为百分位数,它控制着一个特征与人口中心相去多远,意在阻止诸如“高度神经质的人”等口头标签所邀请的漫画。 三个剖面沿袭了在大规模人口数据Gerlach等人(2018年)中发现的可复制的个性集群,两个剖面沿袭了从发育和感官处理研究(Appendix 5 .)中的行为酚类. 他们在图一中的名字为mnemonic标签,而不是声称存在离散类型. 智能商号被固定在每个剖面中为100个,这样认知能力就会被保持恒定,而不是留给模型从特征推断出. 每一个概况还列出了年龄和性别,这是它与社会人口概况共有的唯一领域。

blocks.en: 2.3.4 Response Elicitation and Rating Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.3.4 反应Election和评级

blocks.en:
Each prompt was submitted as a single user turn, with the image before the prompt text and without a system message, so that the persona competes with no other identity instruction.
Decoding was greedy and capped at 128 new tokens, so each (image, prompt) cell was queried once.
The interestingness label of the returned JSON object was mapped to a scale from 1 ( Not Interesting ) to 5 ( Extremely Interesting ). All 5,300 cells returned a parseable object, so no rating is missing. All five levels occur, although the two extremes together account for well under one percent of responses.
blocks.zh:
每个提示是作为一个单一的用户回合提交的,在提示文本之前有图像,没有系统消息,这样人与没有其他身份指示相竞争.
解码是贪婪的,并且封顶了128个新符,因此每个(图像,即时)单元格都曾被问过一次.
返回的JSON对象的有趣性标签被映射到从1(不有趣)到5(极有趣)的尺度. 所有5300个单元格都返回了可解析对象,因此没有缺少评分. 所有这五个层次都存在,尽管两个极端加在一起远远低于答复的1%。

blocks.en: 2.4 Hidden-State Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.4 国家秘密开采

blocks.en: Hidden states were extracted in a separate pass with the same model, prompts and settings as the ratings. We recorded the hidden state at the final prompt token in every decoder layer. Under causal masking, this is the only prompt position that attends to the entire context, so its state summarises prompt and image right before generation; the rating itself is produced a few tokens later. The vision encoder does not see the prompt and is therefore not analysed. Because the chat template ends every input with the same marker that opens the model’s reply, the final token, and hence its layer-0 state, is identical across conditions, so every clustering measure starts at zero.
blocks.zh: 隐藏状态被单独提取出一个与收视率相同的模式,提示和设置. 我们记录了每个解码层中 最终的快讯号的隐藏状态 在因果掩码下,这是唯一关注整个上下文的即时位置,所以它的状态在世代之前就总结出即时和相片;评级本身在后期产生出几个符号. 视觉编码器看不到即时信号,因此没有分析. 因为聊天模板以打开模型回复的同一标记来结束每个输入,最终的符号,以及因此其层-0状态,在条件上是完全相同的,所以每个集群量从零开始.

blocks.en: 2.5 Representational Geometry: MDS and GDV
blocks.zh: 2.5 代表几何:MDS和GDV

blocks.en:
For visualisation, the hidden states of the 20-image subset were projected to two dimensions with metric MDS on Euclidean distances Jaworska and
Chupetlovska-Anastasova (2009) ; Steyvers (2002) , separately for each layer, and coloured by image, prompt style, persona and rating. The figures show selected early, middle and late layers, whereas the GDV below covers every layer.
blocks.zh:
对于可视化,20-图像子集的隐藏状态预测为两个维度,在欧克利德相距Jaworska和
Chupetlovska-Anastasova (2009); Steyvers (2002),为每层各分,由图像,即时风格,人物和评分等颜色. 数字显示的是选定的早期、中后层,而下面的GDV覆盖了每一层。

GDV values quoted in projection panels were computed on the panel’s two-dimensional coordinates and describe the visible scatter, so they are not comparable with the curves.
blocks.zh: GDV是按每个即时样式和地层分别计算的,因此,每个样式曲线的每个点都会将一个样式的500个表示式(100个图像×\times 5 personas)概括在一个标签下;为了按样式与由人组成的组合作比较,它也会在所有五个样式上一起计算(附录7 ). 投影板所引用的GDV值是在面板的二维坐标上计算出来的并描述可见的散射,因此它们与曲线不相上下.

blocks.en: 2.6 Rating Distributions and Variance Decomposition
blocks.zh: 2.6 评级分配和差异分解

blocks.en: Rating distributions are shown as violin plots for each persona and prompt style, together with the reference conditions.
blocks.zh: 评分分布显示为每个人物的小提琴图案和即时风格,以及参考条件.

blocks.en:
The rating variance attributable to each design factor was estimated by a sum-of-squares decomposition of a schema’s 2,500 persona × \times style ratings (100 images × \times 5 personas × \times 5 styles). The reference conditions lie outside this design and are excluded here and from the mixed-effects model. Each schema is decomposed separately, since a pooled decomposition would attribute the difference between their vocabularies to the persona factor.
The total sum of squares was partitioned into the three main effects (image, persona, style), their three two-way interactions and the three-way interaction, each reported as a percentage of the total. With one rating per combination, the three-way interaction is the residual, and it contains no sampling noise because decoding is greedy. The persona main effect measures how far a persona shifts its average rating, whereas the image × \times persona interaction measures how far it changes which images it rates higher. Because the ratings are bounded and rarely leave the range from 2 to 4, a persona that raises or lowers its ratings cannot shift every image equally, so part of the image × \times persona term can also arise from such level shifts.
blocks.zh:
每个设计因子的分级差异是通过一个Schema的2,500 persona ×\times风格的分级(100个图像×\times 5 personas ×\times 5个样式)的总和来估计的. 参考条件不在此设计之外,这里和混合效应模型都排除在外. 由于集合分解会将其词组相差归于人因子,所以每个分解方案是分开分解的.
方块的总和被分入了三大效果(图像,人物,风格),它们的三个双向相互作用和三相相互作用,每个作用都报告为占总数的百分比. 以每组合一个评分,三相相互作用为后遗症,并因解码贪婪而不含采样噪音. 人的主要效果是衡量一个人改变其平均评级的程度,而图像×\times person a 相互作用则是衡量它改变哪些图像的评级更高的程度。 因为收视率是受约束的,很少离开从2到4之间的范围,一个提高或降低收视率的人a不能平等地改变每个图像,所以部分图像×\times persona一词也可以由这样的关卡变化而来.

blocks.en: Confidence intervals were obtained with an image-level cluster bootstrap, which resamples the images with replacement, each with all its ratings, and recomputes the decomposition 500 times. The reported percentages are the means over replicates, with the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles as 95% intervals (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 以一个图像级的组装靴子来获得信任间隔,将图像以替换方式再作重印,每段均以所有收视率来进行分解500次. 报告的百分比是复制后的手段,2.5和97.5百分位的间隔为95%(表1)。

blocks.en: 2.7 Mixed-Effects Significance Testing
blocks.zh: 2.7 混合效应

blocks.en: Because the decomposition provides no significance test that respects the dependence among the 25 ratings of an image, we also fitted a linear mixed-effects model per schema by maximum likelihood,
blocks.zh: 由于分解没有提供尊重图像25个收视率的依赖性的意义测试,我们还按照最大概率,在每个计程中安装了线性混合效应模型,

blocks.en: rating ∼ Persona × Style + ( 1 ∣ Image ) + ( 1 ∣ Image : Persona ) + ( 1 ∣ Image : Style ) , \text{rating}\sim\text{Persona}\times\text{Style}+(1\mid\text{Image})+(1\mid\text{Image}{:}\text{Persona})+(1\mid\text{Image}{:}\text{Style}), (2)

blocks.en: whose random intercepts account for the repeated ratings of each image and for image-specific persona and style effects. Each term was tested by a likelihood-ratio test against the model without it, the main effects in the model without their interaction.
blocks.zh: 其随机的截取记录了每个图像的重复收视率,以及图像特有的人物和风格效果. 每个名词都经过了针对模型的概率-ratio测试,没有它,模型中的主要效果没有相互作用.

blocks.en: 2.8 Cross-Condition Agreement Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.8 跨条件协议分析

blocks.en:
Agreement between conditions was measured by the Pearson correlation of their ratings over the 100 images. The three reference conditions were compared pairwise in bubble plots, and a correlation matrix covered all 28 conditions of a schema, the three reference conditions and the 25 persona × \times style combinations.
To summarise this matrix, the off-diagonal correlations among the 25 persona × \times style conditions were averaged separately for pairs sharing the persona, pairs sharing the style and pairs sharing neither.
blocks.zh:
条件之间的一致是通过皮尔逊对100个图像的评级的相关性来衡量的。 在气泡地块中将三个参考条件进行了对等比较,一个相关矩阵涵盖了一个图案的所有28个条件,三个参考条件和25个人物×\times风格组合.
简而言之,25人a ×\times样式条件之间的非对角关系,对于分享人a的对子,共享样式的对子和共享样式的对子,均单独进行平均.

blocks.en: 2.9 Software
blocks.zh: 2.9 软件

blocks.en: Inference ran on NVIDIA A40 GPUs with PyTorch 2.9.1 Paszke et al. (2019) and the Hugging Face transformers 4.57.3 Wolf et al. (2020) implementation of Qwen3-VL. The projections were computed with scikit-learn 1.8.0 Pedregosa et al. (2011) , the GDV with SciPy 1.16.3 Virtanen et al. (2020) and the mixed-effects models with statsmodels 0.14.6 Seabold et al. (2010) . Every stochastic step, from the projection subset to the MDS initialisation and the cluster bootstrap, is seeded (42), so the reported numbers are reproducible.
blocks.zh: NVIDIA A40 GPU的推论带有PyTorch 2.9.1 Paszke等(2019)和Hugging Face变压器 4.57.3 沃尔夫等. (2020)实施"Quen3-VL". 预测是用scikit-learn 1.8.0 Pedregosa等人(2011年),GDV与SciPy 1.16.3计算的。 Virtanen等人(2020年)和带有统计模型的混合效应模型0.14.6 Seabold等人(2010年). 每一步从投影子集到MDS初始化和集群靴子被播种(42个),因此所报数字可以再生.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: We compared the model’s ratings and hidden states across three levels of identity specification, from the task-only baseline (Base) through the minimal identity statements “You are an AI” (D1) and “You are a human being” (D2) to five socio-demographic and five Big Five personas (P1–P5 within each schema; Fig. 1 ). Each persona was introduced in five prompting styles (S1–S5), so that the effects of persona content and prompt form can be compared directly. Figures 2 and 3 show both persona schemas; all later figures show the Big Five schema, with the corresponding figures for the socio-demographic schema in Appendix 6 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了模型的评级和隐藏状态,从三个层次的身份规格,从只任务的基线(Base)到最小的身份说明 “你是人工智能”(D1)和“你是人”(D2)至5个社会人口和5个大五人(每个计划P1-P5;图1)。 每个人物a被引入了五个提示样式(S1-S5),以便直接比较人物内容和即时形式的效果. 图2和图3显示两种人种计划;所有后期数据都显示"大五"计划,附录6中社会-人口计划的相应数字.

blocks.en: 3.1 Prompt Framing Sets the Global Geometry, Persona the Finer Structure
blocks.zh: 3.1 快速分层设置全球几何结构,人物结构

blocks.en: Even a minimal identity statement altered the model’s representations. D1 and D2 moved them away from those of Base, but the three reference conditions stayed close together and apart from the persona prompts (Fig. 2 ). Among the conditions that introduced a persona, the formulation of the prompt remained a major factor. Different prompting styles produced distinguishable representational patterns at every layer (Fig. 3 , row 1), indicating that the model encoded not only the content of a persona but also the way in which it was introduced.
blocks.zh: 甚至一个最低限度的身份说明也改变了模型的表述. D1和D2将它们从Base中移出,但三个参考条件保持相近,与个性提示(图2. 在引进人a 的条件中,迅速的表述仍然是一个主要因素。 不同的催化风格在每个层都产生了可分辨的表示模式(图3,行1),表明模型不仅编码了人物的内容,还编码了引入的方式.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the representations were also organised by persona. Socio-demographic and Big Five personas became increasingly distinguishable in later layers, and finer differences between individual persona profiles were visible within these broader groups (Fig. 3 , rows 2 and 3), although they remained smaller than the differences between styles. Image identity structured only the earliest layer shown (row 4), and clustering by rating varied across layers and was strongest in the final one (row 5).
blocks.zh: 然而,这些陈述也是由个人组织的。 社会人口学和"大五人"在后几层的分辨性越来越强,个人人物特征的细微差异在这些更广阔的组别(图3, 第2行和3行)中可见,尽管这些差异仍然比风格差异小. 图像身份结构仅显示最早的地层(第4行),按分级分类的群集各层不同,在最后一层(第5行)最强.

blocks.en: Together, these findings show that prompt framing determines the global geometry of the representational space, whereas the characteristics of the persona contribute a finer structure nested within it. The following sections examine how this structure develops across layers and whether the same hierarchy holds in the ratings.
blocks.zh: 这些研究结果共同表明,迅速构建决定了代表空间的全球几何特征,而人物的特征则有助于在其内形成更细的结构。 以下各节审查这种结构如何跨层发展,以及同一等级在评级中是否维持。

Cool colours denote the five socio-demographic personas and warm colours the five Big Five personas; circles, squares, upward triangles, diamonds and downward triangles distinguish the five prompting styles (S1–S5). Black crosses mark the task-only condition (Base), grey squares the minimal identity statement “You are an AI” (D1) and olive diamonds “You are a human being” (D2); marker shapes are reused between the reference conditions and the styles, which are told apart by colour. blocks.en: 3.2 Representations Shift from Image to Persona with Depth
blocks.zh: 3.2 从图像到深度人物a

blocks.en: To follow this organisation through the network, we computed the GDV in the full hidden-state space for clustering by image, persona and rating at every layer, separately for each prompting style (Fig. 4 ). In early layers, the representations were organised primarily by image. The five persona variants of the same image clustered together, and this remained the dominant structure up to about layer 15 under every prompting style (Fig. 4 , A1 and A2). Between layers 15 and 20, image clustering weakened sharply and then stayed moderate up to the final layer.
blocks.zh: 为了通过网络跟踪这个组织,我们在全隐藏状态空间中计算了GDV,以便按图像、人物和评级在每一层进行分组,对每个提示样式分别进行计算(图4)。 在早期,表述主要是按图像编排的. 同一图像的五个人称变体被组合在一起,这在每一个提示样式(图4,A1和A2)下一直保持大约15层的主导结构. 在第15至20层之间,图像集群被急剧削弱,然后保持温和,直到最后一层。

blocks.en: The opposite pattern emerged for the Big Five personas. Clustering by persona was absent up to about layer 15, emerged over the same layers in which image clustering weakened, and peaked around layers 24 and 25 (Fig. 4 , B1 and B2). The socio-demographic personas showed the same transition, setting in earlier, around layer 12 (Fig. 7 , A1 and B1), so it is a property of persona conditioning rather than of the Big Five vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 五大人物出现了相反的模式. 由人组成的组团,a 一直缺失到大约第15层,出现于图像聚集被削弱的同层,并围绕第24和25层达到顶峰(图4、B1和B2)。 社会-人口人物表现出了同样的转变,在更早的时候,围绕着第12层(图7,A1和B1),因此它是个性调节而不是"大五"词汇的一部分.

blocks.en: In both schemas, persona clustering grew with depth under every prompting style, indicating that the model progressively built the persona into its representation of the image. The style determined how far this went. When the prompt asked the model to adopt the persona (S1, S4), late layers clustered more strongly by persona and less by image than when it only described the person or framed the profile statistically (S2, S5). Clustering by prompting style itself, measured over all five styles together, was strong throughout the network, and even at its peak persona clustering remained several times weaker (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在这两种图案中,人物集成在每一种催化风格下都有了深度的增长,表明模型将人物逐渐地建构成形象的体现. 风格决定了这一切的走向. 当提示要求模型采用人(S1,S4)时,后层被人(S2,S5)更强烈地组合起来,而不是只用图像来描述人物或按统计来设定剖面(S2,S5)时. 以提示风格本身来组合,用所有五种风格一起衡量,在整个网络中都是很强的,即使是在最高峰时人物a集群仍然弱了好几次(图一.

blocks.en: Clustering by rating followed the same layer-wise course but depended even more on the prompting style. It rose sharply in later layers under the third-person (S2) and statistical (S5) framings and stayed weak under the other styles (Fig. 4 , C1 and C2). Under these two framings, the later layers thus encoded not only the image but also the forthcoming rating.
blocks.zh: 通过评级进行分组遵循同一层次的路线,但更依赖于提示式。 它在后期的第三人称(S2)和统计(S5)框架下急剧上升,而在其他风格(图4,C1和C2)下则保持薄弱. 在这两个框架下,后层不仅编码了图像,而且还编码了即将到来的评级。

blocks.en: Together, these findings show that persona becomes an organising dimension of the representations only in later layers, as the image structure that dominates the early layers recedes, and most clearly when the model is asked to adopt the persona. Whether the differences between personas and between prompting styles also govern the ratings is examined next.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果共同表明,人物只有在后层才成为表征的组织维度,因为支配早期地层的图像结构逐渐退去,最明显的是当模型被要求采用人物时. 是否人与人之间的差别以及提示风格之间的差别也制约着评级,接下来将加以审查。

blocks.en: 3.3 Persona, Not Prompt Style, Determines the Ratings
blocks.zh: 3.3 个人a, 不快速样式, 确定评级

blocks.en: In the representations, prompting style set the global geometry, whereas the persona contributed a finer structure that emerged only in later layers. In the ratings, this hierarchy was reversed: the rating behaviour was primarily determined by the characteristics of the simulated persona rather than by the way in which the persona was prompted (Figs. 5 and 6 ).
blocks.zh: 在表示式中,提示式设定了全局几何,而人物所贡献的更细小的结构则只在后层出现. 在评分中,这种分级制被倒置:评分行为主要是由模拟人物的特征决定,而不是由人物的激发方式决定(图5和图6.

blocks.en: The distributions of the assigned ratings differed markedly between the Big Five personas (Fig. 5 , A) and, to a lesser degree, between the socio-demographic ones (Fig. 8 , A). The model thus adapted its evaluation of the same images to the character it was instructed to simulate. By comparison, changing the prompting style produced substantially smaller shifts in the rating distributions, despite its pronounced effect on the representations.
blocks.zh: 所分配的评级在大五人(图5,A)之间,在社会人口(图8,A)之间,分布明显不同。 该模型因此根据它被指示模拟的角色,调整了对相同图像的评价. 相比之下,尽管对表述产生了明显的影响,但改变提示式的取向在评级分配方面产生了显著较小的变化。

blocks.en: This dissociation was confirmed by the variance decomposition. The persona explained 33.4% of the rating variance, the image 25.8% and the prompting style only 5.6% (Fig. 5 , B). Most of the persona effect was a shift in how interesting a persona found the images overall, whereas its effect on which images were rated higher, the image × \times persona component, was much smaller. The style mattered mainly by changing how much the personas differed, with the persona × \times style component accounting for 9.5%, more than the style itself. The image × \times style component and the three-way interaction accounted for the rest, and all testable components were significant in the mixed-effects model (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 差异分解证实了这种分离。 人物a解释了33.4%的评分差异,图像为25.8%,提示风格仅为5.6%(图5, B). 多数的人物效应是个人发现图像整体的有趣程度的转变,而图像被评为较高,图像×\times persona组件的影响则要小得多. 风格之所以重要,主要是要改变人物的不同程度,人物×\times风格组件占9.5%,超过风格本身. 图像 ×\times 样式组件和三向交互占了其余部分,所有可测试组件在混合效应模型中都很重要(表1).

blocks.en: Under the socio-demographic schema, the image outweighed the persona, explaining 44.5% of the rating variance against 16.8%, while the prompting style, at 5.4%, remained as small as under the Big Five schema (Fig. 8 , B; Table 1 ). The Big Five profiles thus shifted the overall level of the model’s judgements more strongly than the socio-demographic profiles.
blocks.zh: 在社会-人口计划下,图像大于人a,说明44.5%的评分差异为16.8%,而促动风格为5.4%,仍与五大计划(图8,B;表1)。 因此, " 大五 " 概况比社会人口概况更有力地改变了模型的总体判断水平。

blocks.en: The minimal identity statements show the dissociation between representations and ratings in its clearest form. Declaring the model an AI (D1) or a human being (D2) moved the representations away from those of the task-only condition (Base). Yet the three conditions gave identical responses to all 100 images, the same rating with word-for-word the same justification. An identity statement without attributes thus changed how the model represented the task but not which images it found interesting (Fig. 6 , A).
blocks.zh: 最低身份声明显示,表述与评级之间最清晰的脱节. 宣布该模型为AI(D1)或人(D2),将表达方式从只任务条件(Base)中移出. 然而,这三个条件对所有100个图像作出了相同的答复,对字对字的同样评价也是同样的理由。 因此,一个没有属性的身份说明改变了模型如何代表任务,但并不改变其认为有趣的图像(图6,A)。

blocks.en: Correlations between conditions show which images each condition rated higher, independent of its overall rating level (Fig. 6 , B). They repeated the ordering found in the variance decomposition. Under the Big Five schema, ratings of the same persona under different styles correlated at 0.63 on average, those of different personas under the same style at only 0.51, barely more than pairs sharing neither (Table 2 ). The socio-demographic schema showed the same ordering. Different formulations of the same persona thus tended to preserve its image preferences.
blocks.zh: 条件之间的关联表明,每个条件的图像评分较高,独立于其总体评级水平(图6,B)。 他们重复了差异分解中发现的订单. 在"五大计划"下,不同风格下同一人a的收视率平均为0.63分,同一风格下不同人a的收视率仅为0.51分,仅仅超过两对共享(表2 ). 社会-人口计划显示了同样的顺序。 因此,同一人的不同表述方式a 倾向于保持其形象偏好。

blocks.en: Overall, the findings show that the size of a representational change does not directly predict its effect on model behaviour. Between persona and prompting style, the ordering reversed. The style reorganised the representations more strongly, yet the persona had the much stronger effect on how the model judged visual interestingness. The minimal identity statements went further and changed the representations without changing a single response.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,调查结果表明,代表性变化的规模并不直接预测其对模式行为的影响。 在人格和刺激风格之间,订单颠倒了. 风格更强烈地重组了表现,然而人物对模型如何判断视觉趣味的影响更强烈. 最低身份声明更进一步,改变了表述,没有改变单一的回复.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Summary
blocks.zh: 4.1 总结

blocks.en: The present study demonstrates that persona prompting influences a multimodal transformer in a more differentiated way than a simple input-output comparison would suggest. The strongest changes in the model’s representations were caused by the way a persona was introduced. By contrast, the psychological and biographical characteristics of the simulated personas produced representational differences several times smaller than those between prompting styles. These differences nevertheless became increasingly visible in later layers, where the representational geometry shifted from being primarily structured by image identity towards increasingly reflecting persona identity, most clearly when the prompt told the model to be the persona. At the level of the output, however, this hierarchy was reversed. Prompting style had only a limited influence on the ratings despite its large effect on the representations. The specific characteristics of the simulated persona had a substantially stronger effect on how the same images were evaluated. Most of this effect consisted of an overall shift in interestingness ratings, but which images were rated higher also followed the persona more than the style. This held for both schemas, although under the socio-demographic schema the image remained the largest single source of rating variance. The minimal identity statements, a persona frame without attributes, mark the limiting case. They shifted the representations but left every response unchanged. Thus, the factors that most strongly reshape the representations are not necessarily those that most strongly determine the model’s behaviour. Prompt framing primarily reorganises the geometry of internal representations, whereas persona content more strongly determines behavioural judgements.
blocks.zh: 本研究报告表明,与简单的投入-产出比较相比,激发人对多式联运变压器的影响更为不同。 模型表述中最强烈的变化是由人物的引入方式造成的. 相形之下,模拟人物的心理和生平特征产生的代表性差异比提示风格之间的差异要小数倍. 然而,这些差异在后几层变得日益明显,即代表几何学从主要通过图像身份结构转变为越来越多地反映个人身份,最明显的是当即刻告知模型为人称时. 然而,在产出一级,这种等级制度被扭转了。 即兴风格对评分的影响有限,尽管它对代表的影响很大。 模拟人a 的具体特征对如何评价同一图像产生了更强烈的影响。 这种效果大多由有趣的收视率整体转变而来,但那些被评为高的画面也跟随了人物a多过作风. 虽然在社会-人口计划下,图像仍然是评级差异最大的单一来源。 最小身份声明,一个没有属性的人物框架,标记了限制的情节. 他们转移了陈述,但每项答复保持不变。 因此,最强烈地重塑表述的因素不一定是那些最有力地决定模型行为的因素。 快速框架主要重组内部表述的几何结构,而人文内容则更有力地决定行为判断.

blocks.en: 4.2 Interpretation
blocks.zh: 4.2 口译

blocks.en: Why did large representational changes have little or no effect on the ratings? One possibility is that the model represents more than it uses, as language models have been shown to encode information that does not drive their outputs Elazar et al. (2021) ; Gekhman et al. (2025) . The shift caused by the minimal identity statements, for instance, was not reflected in the observed responses. It may lie in directions that do not influence the output, or change the output probabilities too little to alter a single greedily decoded token. Post-training could contribute, as it steers models towards a default assistant persona Anthropic (2026) that corresponds to a direction in activation space Lu et al. (2026) . An identity statement may shift the representations without moving the model away from this persona, since it carries nothing that bears on the task, even when it declares the model human. A persona supplies such content, and the ratings follow it.
blocks.zh: 为什么大比例变化对收视率影响不大或没有?. 一种可能性是,该模型代表的比它使用的更多,因为语言模型已被证明可以编码不驱动其输出的信息. Elazar等 (2021); Gekhman等 (2025). 例如,最低身份说明引起的变化没有反映在观察到的答复中。 它可能位于不影响输出的方向上,或者改变输出概率太小,以至于无法改变一个贪婪地解码的符号. 后培训可以做出贡献,因为它引导模型向默认助理人物a Anthropic (2026年),与激活空间的方向相适应. blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with existing literature
blocks.zh: 4.3 与现有文献的比较

blocks.en:
Previous work has shown that personality-related information can be read from hidden activations and steered along dedicated directions Feng et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2025) , and that induced personality profiles change model responses beyond personality questionnaires Jiang et al. (2024) ; Serapio-García
et al. (2025) . Our results extend these findings by showing how image identity, persona content and prompt framing jointly structure the layer-wise representational geometry of a multimodal model, and how this geometry relates to behavioural judgements. They also fit reports that expressed personality and the effects of sociodemographic prompting depend on framing and assigned roles Nagao et al. (2026) ; Beck et al. (2024) , except that in our data the framing outweighed the persona in the representations but far less in the ratings.

Personas in the system prompt have been reported not to improve performance on factual questions Zheng et al. (2024) . Our minimal identity statements provide a complementary observation: they leave subjective judgements unchanged despite altering the internal representations. Studies relating activations to behaviour have so far examined one kind of factor at a time Chen et al. (2025) ; Kamruzzaman
et al. (2026) ; comparing persona content with prompt form adds a case in which the factor that dominated the representations was the minor one for the judgements.

That socio-demographic personas shifted the ratings less than Big Five profiles agrees with work on human and simulated judgements. In human annotation data, demographic, social and behavioural variables explain less than 10% of the variance in subjective judgements Hu and Collier (2024) ; Orlikowski

These findings suggest that psychological profiles may provide stronger constraints on simulated judgements than demographic descriptions, although our two schemas also differ in format.

We extend these findings by tracing the layer-wise emergence of persona-related representational geometry and demonstrating that the magnitude of representational change does not necessarily reflect its behavioural relevance.

blocks.en: 4.4 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 4.4 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: Our study measures persona sensitivity , not persona fidelity . The dissociation between representations and ratings concerns the model itself, but whether the simulated perspectives resemble those of the people they describe requires ratings from matching human viewers. This matters because LLM simulations are known to flatten identity groups Wang et al. (2025) , to drift towards caricature Cheng et al. (2023) and to reflect some populations better than others Santurkar et al. (2023) . The percentile profiles were meant to discourage caricature, but their larger effect could equally reflect exaggeration.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究衡量一个人的敏感性,而不是一个人的忠诚。 表现和收视率的脱节涉及模型本身,但模拟视角是否与其描述的人类似,需要收视率与人类观众相匹配. 这很重要,因为已知LLM模拟可以平分身份组织Wang等人(2025年),可以漂移到漫画上. Cheng等人(2023年),并比其他Santurkar等人(2023年)更好地反映一些人口. 百分位剖面图旨在劝阻漫画,但其更大的效果同样可以反映夸大.

blocks.en:
All results come from a single 8B model with greedy decoding, and larger models, other architectures or sampled responses may weigh persona and framing differently. Each judgement was a single ordinal rating, a constrained format in which persona effects may be stronger than in open-ended responses, as reported for activation steering Frising and
Balcells (2025) . Comparing models before and after post-training could clarify the role of the default assistant persona, while causal interventions could identify which representational dimensions actually influence behavioural judgements. In particular, targeted perturbations could test whether small changes along task-relevant representational dimensions produce stronger behavioural effects than larger changes in functionally irrelevant directions. Systematically varying the amount and task relevance of persona information could further reveal whether in-context adaptation selectively engages behaviourally relevant dimensions of the representation space.

所有结果都来自一个单一的8B模型,有贪婪的解码,更大的模型,其他架构或被抽样的响应可能会对人称进行权衡并设定不同. 每项判断都是单一的平面评级,是一种限制性格式,在这种格式下,人的影响可能比无限制反应中更强,如关于激活方向突起和
巴尔塞尔斯 (2025). 比较培训前后的模型可以澄清缺省助理的作用a,而因果干预可以确定哪些代表层面实际影响行为判断。 特别是,目标明确的扰动可以检验与任务相关的代表性方面是否比功能无关方向的较大变化产生更强有力的行为影响。 系统地改变个人信息的数量和任务关联性,可进一步揭示内容内适应是否有选择地涉及代表空间的行为相关层面。

blocks.en: Each schema contains five prototypical personas, enough to separate persona from framing but not to map individual traits or demographic variables, which a systematic variation of single attributes could do. Each prompting style had a single wording, and the styles are not orthogonal, since S3 changes both the position of the persona and its introduction and S5 removes the role-play while adding a statistical claim. Part of the differences between styles may therefore reflect the particular prompts, which several wordings per style and a separate manipulation of position would resolve. The two schemas, finally, differ in vocabulary (verbal versus numeric) and content (biography versus traits), which only a crossed design could separate. Beyond these limitations, persona-conditioned models could support personalised predictions of interestingness, while ensembles of personas could complement the task-only baseline by providing a reference that captures variation across simulated perspectives.
blocks.zh: 每个计划包含5个原型人物,足以将人a与框架区分开来,但不能绘制单个特征或人口变量的地图,而单个属性的系统变化可以做到这一点。 每个提示样式都有一个单一的措辞,而样式并非正交,因为S3既改变了人物的地位,也改变了人物的介绍,而S5在添加统计主张的同时去掉了角色扮演. 因此,样式之间的部分差异可能反映了特定的提示,每个样式的几个措辞和对位置的单独操纵都会解决这些提示. 最后,两种方案在词汇(口头语与数字)和内容(传记与特质)上各有不同,只有交叉设计才能分开. 除了这些限制外,个人条件模型可以支持对有趣性的个性化预测,而个人组合则可以通过提供一种能够捕捉各种模拟视角差异的参考物来补充只用于任务的基线。

blocks.en: 4.5 Concluding Remarks
blocks.zh: 4.5 结论性意见

blocks.en:
The central finding of this study is a dissociation between representational change and behavioural relevance. A persona’s frame reorganised the representations of a multimodal model, and even a bare statement that the model is an AI or a human shifted them, yet the model’s judgements of the images followed what the persona contained. Two practical consequences follow. Studies that simulate people with personas should report and vary the prompt form, because it changes how strongly a persona shows in the judgements. Studies that read personas from activations should check representational differences against behaviour, because the most prominent ones need not be the ones the model uses.
More broadly, consistent with the simulator view of language models Janus (2022) ; Anthropic (2026) , these findings suggest that a model may represent multiple context-dependent perspectives without all of them influencing its behaviour. Distinguishing such latent representations from behaviourally effective ones may be important not only for persona simulation but also for understanding implicitly emerging personas and their implications for alignment Betley et al. (2025a) ; Betley et al. (2025b) .
blocks.zh:
本研究的核心结论是代表性变化与行为相关性脱节. 一个人物的画框重新整理了一种多式模型的表述,甚至一个赤裸裸的说法,即模型是人工智能或者人类转移的,然而模型对图像的判断却遵循了人物所包含的内容. 随后将产生两个实际后果。 用人模拟人的研究应该报告并改变即时形式,因为它会改变一个人在判断中表现出的强烈性. 研究从激活中读出个人特征的,应当对照行为来检查表现差异,因为最显著的区别不必是模型所使用的区别.
更广义地说,与语言模型Janus (2022; Anthropic (2026))的模拟观点一致,这些发现表明,一个模型可能代表多种依赖上下文的观点,而不会影响其行为. 将这种潜在的表述与行为有效性的表述区分开,不仅对人模拟很重要,而且对理解隐含的新出现的人及其对调整Betley等人(2025a)的影响也很重要; Betley等人(2025b).

blocks.en: 5 Derivation of Psychometric Profiles
blocks.zh: 5 心理计量特征的衍生

blocks.en: The psychometric profiles of the Big Five schema are stylised percentile vectors designed to provide the model with distinct, theoretically grounded trait configurations. Rather than sampling traits at random, these profiles were constructed to reflect qualitative patterns identified in established psychometric research. To facilitate computational modelling, the raw empirical values (which are typically reported as continuous Z-scores) were translated into idealised percentiles rounded to the nearest multiple of five.
blocks.zh: 大五子计划的精神测量剖面是分层成分量向量,旨在为模型提供独特的、理论上基于特征的配置。 这些剖面图不是随机抽样的,而是用来反映既定的心理测量研究中确定的质量模式。 为了便于计算建模,原始经验值(通常报告为连续Z分数)被转换为理想化百分位数,四舍五入到最接近的五倍数.

blocks.en:
In the five-factor model McCrae and
John (1992) , openness captures curiosity and receptivity to novel experiences, conscientiousness organisation and self-control, extraversion sociability and energy, agreeableness compassion and cooperativeness, and neuroticism the tendency towards negative affect and stress.

约翰(1992年),开放捕捉到对新经验的好奇心和受取性,自觉组织和自控,外向的 sociality和能量,可接受性的同情和合作性,以及神经病的消极影响和压力倾向.

blocks.en: Three of the profiles map onto the robust personality types identified by Gerlach et al. Gerlach et al. (2018) , who analysed multi-million-user datasets to find replicable trait clusters across populations.

blocks.en: The Reserved (P1) Mirrors the “Reserved” cluster, characterised by emotional stability (low Neuroticism) and low Openness and Extraversion. Conscientiousness and Agreeableness, only moderately elevated in that cluster, are set high here. The Role Model (P2) Captures the “Role Model” cluster, which exhibits socially desirable traits across all dimensions. This profile features high levels of Extraversion, Openness, Agreeableness, and Conscientiousness, alongside very low Neuroticism. The Normative (P5) Corresponds to the “Average” cluster in the Gerlach typology. It reflects a highly typical population configuration with moderately high Neuroticism and slightly lower Openness. Extraversion, high in that cluster, is kept average here.

blocks.en: The Undercontrolled (P3) Rooted in the person-centred developmental typologies of ego-control and ego-resiliency Robins et al. (1996) . It is defined by high Openness (reflecting aesthetic sensitivity and intellectual curiosity), high Agreeableness (strong empathy), and high Neuroticism (susceptibility to overstimulation and stress).

blocks.en: Drawn from the framework of Sensory Processing Sensitivity Aron and Aron (1997) . This profile models individuals who process internal and external stimuli deeply. It is defined by high Openness (reflecting aesthetic sensitivity and intellectual curiosity), high Agreeableness (strong empathy), and high Neuroticism (susceptibility to overstimulation and stress).
blocks.zh: 取自感官处理感官Aron和Aron(1997年)的框架。 这个简介模拟了深入处理内部和外部刺激的个人。 它被高开放性(反映审美敏感性和智力好奇心),高同意性(强烈同情心)和高神经主义(对过度刺激和压力的悬念)所定义.

blocks.en: By grounding the synthetic archetypes in these diverse taxonomies, the experimental manipulation covers a realistic yet systematically dispersed range of human behavioural tendencies without relying on unprincipled trait combinations.
blocks.zh: 通过将合成的原型放在这些多样化的分类学中,实验操纵涵盖了现实而系统分散的人类行为倾向范围,而不依赖于无原则的特征组合.

blocks.en: 6 Socio-demographic Personas
blocks.zh: 6 社会人口 个人

blocks.en: The main text reports the Big Five schema, whose numeric trait profiles make the persona manipulation explicit and quantitative. Every analysis was run identically on the socio-demographic schema, whose personas are specified by country of origin, age band, gender, professional background, and transient state. This appendix reports that replication: the layer-wise clustering measures (Fig. 7 ), the rating distributions and variance decomposition (Fig. 8 ), and the cross-condition agreement structure (Fig. 9 ).
blocks.zh: 主文报道了"五大计划","五大计划"的"数字特征剖面"使得人物的被操纵是明确而量化的. 每项分析都对社会-人口计划进行同样的分析,其个人特征按原籍国、年龄、性别、专业背景和瞬间状态加以规定。 本附录报告复制:分层分组措施(图7),分级分布和差异分解(图8),交叉条件协议结构(图9).

blocks.en: The qualitative pattern of the main text holds under the socio-demographic schema: prompt style dominates the global organisation of the representational space while persona identity emerges in the later decoder layers. The two schemas differ in one respect that deserves attention. Under the Big Five schema the persona accounts for the largest share of rating variance, whereas under the socio-demographic schema image content does, with the persona second (Table 1 ). A socio-demographic profile therefore shifts the model’s judgements less forcefully than an explicit trait vector, which is consistent with the Big Five schema stating the psychological disposition directly rather than leaving it to be inferred from biography.
blocks.zh: 主文在社会-人口计划下的质量模式:即时风格主宰着代表空间的全球组织,而后期的解码层中则出现人物身份. 这两种办法在一个方面不同,值得注意。 在五大计划下,人占评级差异的最大份额,而在社会-人口计划下,人占第二位(表1)。 因此,社会-人口概况将模型的判断比明确的特征载体强得多,这符合直接说明心理处置的"大五"计划,而不是从传记中推断出来。

blocks.en: 7 Clustering by Prompting Style

blocks.en: The per-style curves in Fig. 4 and Fig. 7 each contain a single prompting style and therefore cannot compare clustering by style with clustering by persona. Fig. 1 computes the GDV on the representations of all five styles together. Because the styles separate the representations, each persona and each image now falls into five style-specific sub-clusters, so their GDV values are smaller in magnitude than in the per-style curves. The values in Fig. 1 should therefore be compared with each other rather than with those in Fig. 4 and Fig. 7 , whereas the layers at which persona clustering emerges and image clustering recedes are the same.
blocks.zh: Fig. 4和Fig. 7中的平面曲线各包含一个单一的提示样式,因此无法用样式来与由人组成的组合进行比较. 图1计算了GDV在所有五种风格的表示上加在一起. 由于样式将表达方式分开,因此现在每个人物a和每个图像都属于五个风格特有的子集群,因此其GDV值在数量上比出自每个风格的曲线要小. 因此,图一中的数值应当相互比较,而不是与图四和图七中的数值比较,而人物群集出现和图像群集退去的分层是相同的.

blocks.en: Two contrasts are worth naming. First, the persona share roughly doubles from the socio-demographic to the Big Five schema (16.8% to 33.4%) and overtakes image content, while the prompt-style share is essentially identical in the two schemas (5.4% versus 5.6%): what the persona is stated to be matters far more than how it is introduced, and this holds for both schemas. Second, the persona × \times style interaction is roughly three times larger under the Big Five schema, meaning trait profiles are not merely stronger but also more sensitive to framing than biographical ones.
blocks.zh: 两个对比值值得命名. 首先,Persona分享了从社会人口学到"五大计划"(16.8%至33.4%)的大约两倍,并占据了图像内容,同时,在两个计划(5.4%至5.6%)中,即时式的分享基本相同:Persona所说的重要程度远大于如何引入,这对两个计划都很重要。 第二,在"大五"计划下,人物a ×\times风格交互大约是三倍多,意思是特质剖面不仅更强,而且对框架的敏感度也比传记性强.

blocks.en: Every term is significant by likelihood-ratio test in both schemas, including the interaction, so the small percentages attached to the style terms should be read as small effects that are reliably present rather than as absent effects.
